structure.guhs.sausuman_toren.tooltip: The black tower of Sauceruman, the wizard Mika who wants a bite too (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.ringsausuman_ringdeeg.lore: A floppy ring of dough. Not tasty yet. For the Ring Baker
item.guhs.ringsausuman_frituursaus.lore: Sizzling hot. No licking. For the Ring Baker
item.guhs.ringsausuman_ui.lore: The only thing left in there. Round is round, nyeg. For the Ring Baker
item.guhs.ringsausuman_uienring.lore: One ring to eat them all. Not a Nibble Ring, but crispy
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.eerst_pra: This belongs to Sauceruman. Ask him first what he wants with it, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.pak.deeg: The Dough Kneader spits out a floppy ring of dough. Plop. That one is for the Ring Baker.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.pak.saus: You tap a jug of sizzling hot frying sauce. No licking. (Tasty though.)
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.pak.kaas: The Cheese Cupboard is empty. Completely empty. There's only an onion left. Oh well: round is round, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.heb_je.de: You already have ring dough. One ring at a time, says the Dough Kneader.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.heb_je.ka: There was only one onion. You already have it.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.klaar.dee: The Dough Kneader kneads on without much enthusiasm. You don't need anything else here.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.klaar.sau: Drip. Drip. The Sauce Tap is still leaking. You don't need anything else here.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.klaar.kaa: Now the Cheese Cupboard really is completely empty. There's a note on it: 'BUY CHEESE!!'
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.voorraad.nog: %s more to go for the Ring Baker
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.afblijven: HANDS OFF! shouts Sauceruman. Talk to him first before you touch his Ring Baker.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.mist: The Ring Baker rattles, empty. You have %s of the %s things with you: dough, hot sauce and cheese are upstairs in the tower.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.koelt_af: The Ring Baker ticks and cools down. In the corner, somebody is sulking very hard.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.morgen: The Ring Baker has to cool down. Tomorrow it will bake you another onion ring.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.bakker.dagelijks: DING! One fresh onion ring. Sauceruman looks the other way on purpose.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.mikarad.por: The Uruk-Mika looks at you. He doesn't trudge one step faster.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.mikarad.regel: An Uruk-Mika trudges in here. A Mika doesn't run, a Mika gets a ride.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.0: A big eye. It blinks. It's feeling peckish.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.1: Nine riders. They're lost and too shy to ask the way.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.2: A guh running flat out in a wheel. He loves it. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.3: Yourself, from above. You have a crumb on your snoot.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.4: A mountain with the smell of frying coming out of it. It makes you hungry.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.5: Guhdalf. He waves. So he can see you too.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.6: Just sauce. It is only a pan, after all.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.pannantir.7: Sauceruman, secretly sniffing an onion ring. He sees you looking and quickly goes back to sulking.
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.optie.hapje: Want a bite of onion ring?
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.optie.weg: I'll let you sulk for a bit
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.optie.nog_een: May I have another onion ring?
gui.guhs.ringsausuman.beloning.dagelijks: One onion ring from the Ring Baker every day
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.te_vroe: Who are you? No ring? Then you're no use to me. Come back when you've got something round and tasty with you. And wipe your paws!
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hallo: Well, well. The ring-bearer. I can smell it. Cheese. Crispy. ROUND. I am Sauceruman of Many Sauces: I have a sauce for everything, except something tasty to put it on. Give me a bite of that Nibble Ring. One bite! I'm asking nicely. More or less.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hallo_o: WHAT? It's GONE? Fried, shared, and I got NOTHING? Even that Eye got a piece! I am Sauceruman of Many Sauces, I was sitting here ready with EIGHT kinds of sauce! Do you really not have one little crumb left for me?
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.zelf_ne: No? NO? To ME? Fine. Perfect. Then I'll bake one MYSELF.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.zelf_de: Later? LATER? I've been waiting for weeks! You know what? Never mind. I'll bake one MYSELF.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.opdrach: My Ring Baker is finished. Almost. It's just still empty. It needs dough from the Dough Kneader, hot sauce from the Sauce Tap and CHEESE from the Cheese Cupboard. It's all upstairs. Would you fetch it? I have to stay here and be important.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.ingredi: %s more things! Dough one floor up, hot sauce two floors up, cheese three floors up. Up the stairs, nyeg. And keep your paws off my Pannantír!
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hendel: Everything in? Then pull the lever of the Ring Baker! No wait, I want to... no. You do it. If it blows up, it was you.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.mok: ... I'm not saying anything. I'm sulking. I wanted a Nibble Ring, with CHEESE. This is an ONION RING. That's a VEGETABLE. Go away.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.hapje: ... Give it here. *nibble* ... *nibble nibble* ... Nyeg. Pretty tasty. BUT I'M STILL SULKING. Here, take that pan with you, all I ever see in it is that Eye anyway. And those onion rings too. I don't want them. (Leave one behind.)
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.opgeget: You ate it YOURSELF? With me sitting RIGHT HERE? Now I'm sulking DOUBLE. Here, take that pan with you, I never want to see anything round again. And those onion rings too. Yes, I secretly baked a few more. Don't say a word.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.weg: Fine. Off you go. I'm perfectly happy here. In my corner. Alone. With my beard.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.na: What. I'm sulking. Can't you see? ... Was there anything else?
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.te_zwaa: Too heavy, too heavy... That Inventor Guh from the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant dropped by. 'Sauceruman,' he said, 'five machines on one wheel of %s chonk power, that's too heavy. Then everything stands still. And a GUH belongs in a wheel, not a Mika.' What does HE know? ... He was right. Don't tell him that.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.sausuman.nog_een: The lever. One a day. I'm not looking. I NEVER look.
You've already had one today. The Ring Baker has to cool down. So do I.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.ingrediente: fetch dough, hot sauce and cheese on the three floors of the tower
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.hendel: pull the lever of the Ring Baker, downstairs in the hall
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.mok: Sauceruman is sulking. Offer him a bite of your onion ring
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.hint.klaar: the Ring Baker bakes you one onion ring every day
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.wenk: Do you smell that? Somebody is baking something. It's coming from that black tower, that's where Sauceruman lives. You don't need it for the journey, but your Super Compass knows the way (Barbecue tab), nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringsausuman.wenk_alleen: Not far from the tree city a black tower stands smoking: the Tower of Sauceruman. You don't need it for the journey, but your Super Compass knows the way (Barbecue tab).
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_sausu: One Onion Ring to Eat Them All
Help Sauceruman bake his own ring. It turns out to be an onion ring. He sulks
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.uitleg: Sauceruman of Many Sauces wants a bite of the Nibble Ring too. He doesn't get one, so he bakes his own. What could go wrong? (You don't need this for the journey.)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.0: Go to the black tower and talk to Sauceruman. He wants something from you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.0: The Tower of Sauceruman, a short walk from Guhladriel's tree city
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.1: Fetch ring dough (one floor up), hot frying sauce (two floors up) and cheese (three floors up) from the tower.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.1: Upstairs in the Tower of Sauceruman
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.2: Pull the lever of the Ring Baker.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.2: The hall of the Tower of Sauceruman
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.3: Sauceruman is sulking in his Sulking Corner. Offer him a bite of your onion ring.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.waar.3: The hall of the Tower of Sauceruman
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.nu.klaar: Sauceruman is still sulking, but the Ring Baker bakes you an onion ring every day. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.0: Talk to Sauceruman in his tower
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.1: Fetch dough, hot sauce and cheese upstairs in the tower
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.2: Pull the lever of the Ring Baker
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_sausuman.kort.3: Offer Sauceruman a bite of onion ring
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.start: Stand back! Sauceruman of Many Sauces is going to bake a RING!
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.spreuk: One ring to eat them all! One ring to... to... oh well, ONE RING!
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.pling: DING. Something rolls out. It's round. It's crispy. It smells of... onion.
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.ui: That's not a Nibble Ring. That's an ONION RING. Who put ONION in there?!
scene.guhs.ringsausuman_bakken.mok: I wanted CHEESE. This is a VEGETABLE. Go away. I'm sulking.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_baltoguh.afslag: Hmmm. I think I chonked down a wrong turn... There's no medicine chest here...
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_kistje.zocht: Somebody was looking for that, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_spiegel.titel: One More Thing in the Mirror
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_spiegel.visioen: The mirror shows one more thing: Guhtwo, tucking into a double helping.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_stitch.titel: Who Keeps Letting That Thing In?
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_stitch.wie: WHO keeps letting that thing in?!
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_boris.berg: A normal guh can't climb this mountain... but maybe, just maybe...
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjokkel.ver: And there... comes one more. Very. Slowly.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjokkel.sjokkel: It's Shuckly! He's been on his way since the bridge in Nibblemoria.
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_sjokkel.toetje: Just in time for dessert, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringknipoog_kloon.twee: Two rings is twice as tasty!
quest.guhs.ringknipoog.sjokkel.brug: Look at that: there goes Shuckly, shuffling onto the bridge. Very. Slowly.
quest.guhs.ringknipoog.sjokkel.klik: Shuckly is on his way to a party. Better not disturb him, nyeg.
